_comment: Expectation manifest for test-scope's frozen acceptance-checks.
Enforced repo-wide by scripts/evals-all.mjs on every push and PR.
expect "green" = a past fix that must not regress. MUST exit 0.
expect "red"   = a known-failing check (open concern). MUST exit 0 or 1.
A check file missing from this manifest FAILS the gate.
LOCKED (evals/**): improvement loops may never edit this file.

mutations.why: without the absent-side rule, a manifest new in the range is compared against 'null' and forces run-all even with no dependencies (the 242/249 regression)
mutations.find: if (was === null || now === null) return declaresDeps(f, was ?? now ?? '');

mutations.why: over-correction: treating every added/deleted manifest as no change hides real dependency additions and removals
an added package.json with an empty dependencies {} object declares nothing and must not force run-all
a requirements file holding only comments declares no dependency
a go.mod with only module/go directives declares no dependency
